t: Steal a Holy Cloak from a goblin pirate to the east of Takalik dock and return to Profka the Fierce.

I hate Plu! That mangy prick is dealing with pirates. They brought the holy weapons here! I thought the cheapskate would make fortune by selling his trinkets. Luckily the auction fell through. I'm so happy! And I'll do what I can to make him even more miserable.
Except getting close to those pirates ain't no piece of cake! Plu gave them all holy cloaks to wear, so now they're invincible. We even put up more guards around the port in case they try to attack. Man, what kind of crap is this - we're afraid of goblins! Makes my blood boil.
If only we could get one of those cloaks. Then we'd show them a thing or two! Actually, I've got an idea. Kinda crazy, but still.
The pirates set up camp on the shore east of the port. What if we take one of them by surprise - sneak up on them and rip their cloak off? You'd better be careful though! Their bosun is said to carry a holy blade in addition to wearing a holy cloak!
I can't wait to get my hands on one of those things.
There it is! A holy cloak! Wait, you said you killed its owner? Hold on a second! That means it failed to protect its owner. How could that be?
Steal a Holy Cloak from a goblin pirate to the east of Takalik dock and return to Profka the Fierce.

Capture the pirate bosun's Holy Blade and bring it to Profka the Fierce.
It looks like the holy cloak didn't work, since its owner lies dead on the ground. Profka said something about a holy blade on that pirate bosun. Maybe you should check that out too.
Well, you have a huge smile on your face, so I trust everything went well? Tell me what happened!
Hmm... Hmm... Hmm! Don't mind me, I'm just thinking... and not making any sense out of this!
Capture a Lake Lizard Female for Forestfang the Fierce.

A cage is just the place for this lizardman! Look at that pond scum gawking at us! Muahaha... Some lizardmen were dumb enough to try and attack the port. We minced them good, but we caught this one and put him up in a cage.
After we had our fun we wanted to put him out of his misery, but a Free Trader recommended a sweet little deal. He said we could sell this slime ball to the Suslanger Zoo for a good chunk of cash.
And an even better chunk if he had a scaly chick to go with him. Picture that! All the folks at the zoo are gonna stare at these two creeps do their... woohoo... Awesome, huh?
I like the idea just fine! The darn thing is, I can't get away from the cage. My buddies would snatch him and sell him to that Trader, gal or no gal, and then go off to some bars - good luck finding them then.
But you and me, we're no monsters, right? We won't let the poor slime ball die in Suslanger with no womanly affection. So why don't you go and catch him a honey with this lasso I got. There are lots of the filthy creatures west of here, creeping around the lake. Then we can pawn this sweet couple to that Trader. Deal?
Look at him sitting there, baring his fangs at me! Don't you see - I'm trying to take care of you! Hold on a little longer and we'll bring you a nice babe.
That's just what we need! Hey you, lizardman! Here's a girl for you! Hey, look at that sparkle in his eyes! You da man!
Bring 6 Ether Crystals and 6 Crates of Tea to Afanasy Samovarov.

I'm broke! I come to the port to pick up my goods and what do I learn? My ship's been wrecked on the rocks, and my tea crates are floating all over the Astral! Who's gonna drink it, the demons? Oh, what am I gonna do? Why has the Light forsaken me and my business?
Listen, is there any way you could help me? I'm too fat and clumsy - I might get a heart attack if I go fishing for those crates myself. Could you search for them?
I know, I know, it's not worthy of a warrior like you. But listen to this. As I was standing on the docks, I heard something about ether elementals living here. They say their crystals recently became very valued by the Traders.
Can you go out and collect some while they're still hot? That way you can put your fighting skills to good use and collect the crates at the same time. Maybe I'll end up recovering from my losses, and you'll make some coin too!
Maybe I should have dumped these tea crates and ordered more crystals. Oh well, to heck with that. I don't wanna have a heart attack worrying about every little thing.
Done and done! Here's your money, and here's a detailed note outlining the assistance you gave me. Thanks!
Find and kill whatever is leading the lizardmen on Icemirror Lake and return to Beech the Thickskinned.

My heart is restless. If our savior leaves, what will we do if the monsters descend upon us forestfolk? They breed very quickly, and they will soon replace those you have slain. We need to figure out a way to stop their advances.
I wonder what compelled them to leave Icemirror Lake. They lived there for years, but now they have decided to come to our river. They must have a new leader that is spurring them on, and as long as he is alive us forestfolk will never have rest.
Who could this new leader be, I wonder? Will you seek out this enemy of the forestfolk and vanquish him? Then we can be sure that our future will be free of those vicious creatures.
I can sense that their new leader is commanding the monsters to keep attacking us. He is the root of all the forestfolks' problems.

Thank you, savior! Now the forestfolk can have peace and quiet. Whoever heard of that? A demon in charge of a pack of lizardmen!
Please stay here with us, savior! Be our god! The forestfolk will build a chapel for you and gladly die in your name! No? Then the forestfolk want you to have this gift.
Find and kill whatever is leading the lizardmen on Icemirror Lake and return to Beech the Thickskinned.

Collect the 6 drops of Lizardman Blood and pour it onto the Brazier to summon Sinkaz the Corrupter.

What's this? The diary of that cultist...
"...And the lizardmen are now under the control of the demon..."
A demon is behind all of this! He can't be left here to keep controlling the lizardmen - there must be some way to call him out of hiding... Maybe it has something to do with this brazier.
The brazier gives off an evil aura...
You see the ripples, realizing that it was the demon who caused them! Now you have to defeat the Fiend from the Depth.
Collect 2 "Holy" Cloaks, 2 "Holy" Blades, and 2 "Holy" Hand Grenades from the goblins near Icemirror Lake and bring them to Profka the Fierce in Takalik Harbor.

What if... what if all this holy weapon stuff was just a bunch of lies?
What? You're saying you have accurate information that they used to work? Well, whatever the case may be, they sure don't seem to work now. So here's what you're gonna do.
In the harbor to the southwest, by Icemirror Lake, there's a pirate ship called the Astral Cuttlefish. It's full of goblins armed with these so-called holy weapons. Get close to them, test the waters, and if their cloaks, grenades, and blades are the same kind of garbage, grab as many as you can. Then we can put the squeeze on that little bastard Plu the Tightwad. He's gonna get it real good this time! His entire cartel is going to come crumbling down!
I knew it! Everything that comes out of Plu's mouth is pure hogwash! He's always been a crook and always will be. But now he's trying to pull something that's way over his head!

Plu, ol' buddy ol' pal, say goodbye to your reputation! You might as well close up shop right now! I will personally send mercenaries to the Free Traders' camp to make sure everybody gets word of this!
Collect 4 "Holy" Cloaks, 4 "Holy" Blades, and 4 "Holy" Hand Grenades from the goblins near Icemirror Lake and bring them to Profka the Fierce in Takalik Harbor.

Kill 6 Goblin Corsairs and their captain Kork the Scurvy and return to Profka the Fierce.

I've got a job for you that's kinda personal... If you decide to go to that pirate ship, the Astral Cuttlefish, it would be nice if you could axe all those goblins while you're there, including their captain. I can't wait for him to lose his last damn eye!
These scumbags are attacking our merchant vessels, taking away our profits, and we can't even fight back! Just last week they took out three ships operated by the Free Traders.
It's all because of that damned holy gear that we can't touch 'em. But if it's all a bunch of bull... It's time to get even! Now they'll be sorry they ever crossed the line!
I hate pirates! I hate goblins! And goblin pirates... ain't a word been invented for the way I feel about 'em!
They're dead? Now that's what I call good news!
Show the Encrypted Pirate Map to Profka the Fierce in Takalik Harbor.
A pirate map! But it doesn't make any sense - all the names are scrambled. What a shame. Hm, but what's this cross? Could it be a treasure?! You need to figure this out... Maybe Profka can help you?

Whatcha got here? Show me! Hmm, this is a map pointing to some buried treasure. You're real lucky to have found this.
The only thing is, the map is encrypted. You need a code key to decipher it. Find the code and then you'll learn where the treasure is buried. Keep your eyes open for anything that might work!
Use the Desorotype at the bottom of Icemirror Lake and return to Yaver Amenia.

Back in the times of the June, there used to be a port here too, except it was a sea port. It was also named Takalik Harbor. You see, our lives always have roots in the past, even if we don't notice them.
My specialty is studying June trade routes, but the head of the Historians has ordered us to start researching June architect. He says it has something to do with Tensess Temple... It seems very strange, but I'm not one to disobey orders.
The ruins I am studying are on the bottom of Icemirror Lake. That in itself makes my job a huge pain, but the ruins are also crawling with crazy lizardmen! I've been stuck here for days, unable to do a single thing.
Fortunately I have with me a device called a desorotype. It is able to record an image of its surroundings. If an adventurer like you were to use it at the bottom of the lake, you could bring it back here and I could study the image in peace!
So, do you think you're up for the job? It's very important to the Historians. Just make sure not to damage that desorotype - it's very expensive!
Eljune is a perfect place for Historians because there are so many June ruins here. If not for the war, this place would be a paradise.
Wow, what a pretty picture. It almost feels like I traveled there myself. Thanks, thanks a lot. I'll get busy studying this!
Tell Yaver Amenia of your agreement to help the Historians.

I am a Historian. Because of this my opinions often differ from my fellow Arisen. I understand that there's a brutal war raging between the League and the Empire here, but all of that seems trivial when you look at the big picture.
In my humble opinion, there are many enduring truths and values that are far more meaningful. By studying history we can uncover answers to some of the most important questions of our time.
If you agree to help me and my fellow Historians with our work, I assure you it would be extremely important to not just you or me, but the entire world. Well, do you think you have the time to lend a hand?

Excellent! Half the population of Eljune is busy fighting and the other half is only interested in trade. In the meantime, the secrets of this land remain undiscovered. Perhaps with your help we'll be able to solve them.
The June history is an example set for us.
Tell Yaver Amenia of your agreement to help the Historians.

Bring the Desorotype to the Historian named Antoinette de Grandeur in the Itsmal Ruins.

Wow! I'm glad you're still here! This image is... simply incredible! Listen, the desorotype must be taken to Antoinette de Grandeur right away! She's in the Historians' camp in the Itsmal Ruins, far to the south of here. Please hurry! This is extremely important.
Yaver Amenia took this image from the bottom of Icemirror Lake? Who would have thought that! She's a brave one indeed. Oh... it was you! Now I believe you. Okay, give it here!
Wow, would you look at that!
Use the Desorotype at the northern part of the Itsmal Ruins and return to Antoinette de Grandeur.

So, everything has finally fallen into place. Now we know that the ruins on the bottom of Icemirror Lake, the Jakala Ruins, and the ones we have here are were all parts of the same ancient city.
But what kind of place it was, what was its purpose, and what happened here so many years ago - all this is an enigma.
The Itsmal Ruins appear to be the most important and the most well preserved, so can you please go over there and take a few images with the desorotype? Try and focus on the June inscriptions on the walls - there's a ton of them on that statue to the north. Ooh, I can't wait! We've been waiting to crack this mystery for so long.
Have you taken the images yet? If not, please hurry!

Wow! There are so many inscriptions. "Bob was here." ...No, I guess some Xadaganian wrote that.
But what's this? Hold on, let me translate... Ah, I see! The entire city went by the name of Itsmal, and apparently it was huge! It also seems to be the site of a tragedy that unfolded many centuries ago. The fabled "Curse of the June" appears to be the cause.
Apparently the June soldiers defended their city until the bitter end. "We'd rather die than surrender" - they scratched that on these walls. I can't imagine what could bring such an incredible civilization so low!
The soldiers said they let many June civilians escape that day but, as we all know from our history textbooks, the Curse still caught up with them in the end. And now the June are an extinct people. What a mystery...
Kill 6 Forest Trolls for the Jingly Family.

Oh, hey! We've heard a lot about you. You helped the Potbellied Family get a job with the Historians, and since we're partners, you've unknowingly helped us too! That's why we're here - we're outfitting the archeological camp.
Hey, the Potbellied Family is doing well over there, right? But this ain't some protected bazaar. Just look at the forest next door - the stench of that place means that trolls must be near! Even though we came here with mercenaries, our hair curled just the same!
You see, our mercenaries haven't been doing their job. It seems like the local trolls are too tough for them! Something tells us that you're brave enough to do this. Can you take out a few of those trolls for us, before they wipe out the camp?
Trolls stomp so loudly, and that alone is reason enough to destroy them. We can't even sleep at night!
Here's your note. It was an invaluable service to not only the Traders but the Historians as well!
Kill 4 Black Ravens for the Jingly Family.

We've got something to ask of you... but just don't go blabbing about it everywhere.
It's a bit of an odd request and we would appreciate your confidentiality. There are lots of ravens all around the Itsmal Ruins. Something really weird is going on... Maybe it's just paranoia, but it can't be happening to all three of us at the same time! We can't help but feel that these ravens are in fact very intelligent. They must be spying on us! The mercenaries have complained about them too! Anywhere you go, you always hear their "Caw! Caw!" right above your head. Even when we're discussing business matters, one of them is always there, sitting in a tree and staring right at us!
We'd have a lot more peace around here if all those ravens were shot down!
We hate having to do our business in the bushes with those feathery things peeping at us...
Oh, thank you! What a load off our minds! Here's a note saying that we're in your debt, by the way.
Kill 6 Fierce Werewolves or Fierce Werebears and return to Peter Iliev.

Woe is me! Zosim left without saying a word, and then the sun set. Now the Light is no longer reaching us, and darkness has covered us like a blanket. Before, Zosim would sit by this outpost and teach the pilgrims eternal truths. Birds sang in the air and warmth overflowed the world.
But now he is gone and darkness has brought us many ferocious werebeasts. I feel like dropping everything and leaving to search for Zosim, but I cannot. Before he left, he said to me - do your duty first, and always place the needs of others above your wants and wishes.
Now many pilgrims are coming to this land, unaware that Zosim is missing and the woods have become dangerous. Werebeasts attack people in broad daylight, and I hear some people never reach the sanctuary.
Please protect us - I know you have a tender heart. I will pray for you until the end of days if you help destroy those evil creatures!
Much blood shall be shed until Zosim comes back! It seems the werebeasts can sense that our Light has gone out and the sun has set. Now they spread terror all around and devour travelers at will.
You bear glad tidings! No longer will the werebeasts spread terror on our roads! Tell me, did you see any signs of Zosim in the forest? Oh where can he be, the sun of our lives?
Find a pilgrim that fell behind in the forest and return to Kseniya Soldatova.

I'm going to inform the authorities about this! I'll write to Yasker himself! Pilgrims cannot be treated like this!
The travel agency that sold us this tour warned us it was a wild allod and all that. They said we should keep our eyes open, never wander off road, have a charged wand ready, and wear bug nets at all times. But this?!
Did the program mention werebeasts? I don't remember that at all! And where is Zosim, the renowned Great Ascetic? That's one of the main reasons we endured such an exhausting journey! They promised me Zosim could heal my eczema in a single touch. I spent a fortune just to get here! Those travel agents will be sorry!
Oh, by the way... a few pilgrims from our group fell behind in the forest, and I faintly remember werebeasts howling nearby. You wouldn't happen to be from the local guard, would you? Someone should go check if they're all right...

I'm going to make them pay for this! I mean, how do they get away with selling these awful travel tours? It won't be long before the government puts a lid on their little business! I hope those other pilgrims are okay.
What? They're what? Dead? Nezeb almighty, this place is awful! Ahhhh!
Talk to Peter Iliev and learn about the Great Ascetic's message.
Look! A unicorn approaches, and he has a letter around his neck! It must be a message from Zosim! Here, let me read it!

Zosim writes that he has long noticed the traces of darkness in our Holy Land. Oh, how could I not have noticed? He gave no signs of his fears when he was here...
Demon worshippers - that's who he's caught scent of! Zosim had hoped that all of Sarnaut's inhabitants would stand up to this great danger and together defend the Holy Land. But it doesn't seem like that is meant to be.
The priests from the League and the Empire came to him. They did nothing but quarrel, throw accusations, and refuse to cooperate. This upset Zosim a great deal, and now he's determined to wage a solitary war on the darkness.
Zosim writes that many strange things are happening to the west. But we must rejoice - he's found the root of all this evil and plans to extinguish it! He has already healed a beautiful unicorn and dispatched him to bring us this good news.
It is clear to me now - the strength of his faith had protected our little sanctuary, and when he left the monsters swarmed our forest. Let us hope he vanquishes this evil soon!
Collect 6 pieces of Cursed Bark in Wilderwoods for the Jingly Family.

You don't scare easily, do you? Unlike us... You are interested in Trader's Notes, right?
Hmm, then you can help us. Have you seen the treants around here? They're hideous little things. Hideous and very dangerous. And rare, too! But their rarity makes sense. Why? Let me tell you. Their bark is an incredibly valuable material.
Even the Great Mages would happily pay a fortune for it. Anyway, that's where you come in. You need the notes, right? We'll give you two in exchange for six pieces of Cursed Bark. And we will do this every day! Just bring us the bark!

Six piece of Cursed Bark will get you two Trader's Notes!
He he. It's an interesting world!
Our hero! This'll really make the Potbellied Family wish they had chosen this dump instead!
Find Zosim Nikulin along the Zosim Coast.

At this moment my greatest regret is that I spent my whole life refining my spirit and not my skills in combat. But you - you are a different story. I beg you in the name of everything that is good in this world, in the name of the Light, please hurry and help Zosim!
I am not sure what evil he has discovered, but I know that he shall need all the help he can get to defeat it! I shudder to think what would happen if he was lost in the battle against the demons...
No! I shall not lose faith in him! I shall not lose faith in you! Now go, and help him in whatever way he requests. He says he is to the southwest of here, right outside the edge of the woods.
Beware... The woods is now under the rule of the demons. And even I could not defeat the source of this taint...
Use the Desorotype at the ruins in the woods and return to Antoinette de Grandeur.

The forest to the south is the most terrible of forests, one that is abandoned by all the animals. Apparently that is where the ruins of the main city temple are located.
One of the inscriptions near the statue said... I hope I got my translation right... it said, the Itsmal temple has a depiction of the Curse. It says it's a three-dimensional one, so it can't be a mural. Could it be a statue?
I don't know if this object has been preserved, but we must check it out. Head to the southwest, to the place where the Itsmal Ruins end and the woods begin. Use the desorotype there and take an image of this object. But be extremely careful - I have a bad feeling about that place...
Another puzzle. Why would the June depict their own Curse in their main temple?

So, you got the image! Oh my Light! That isn't... That looks an awful lot like a demon, don't you think? Yes, the image is stylized, like everything the June left us. But these tentacles, this evil grin... Can it really be true?
I know that the Tka-Rik Revelation claimed the June discovered a portal into another world. It said they summoned demons who later destroyed them. But no respected Historian believes that story. Although now... it appears there may be some truth in it.
Use the Desorotype at the ruins in the woods and return to Antoinette de Grandeur.

Heal a Tainted Unicorn with the Ordinary Amulet, then bring a Salty Unicorn Tear to Zosim Nikulin.

You say you want to help. But do you have light and power in you? Do you? Do you know what can change the nature of a sentient being, what can change... the world?
Faith! Do you have it in you? We'll soon see. Only the power of faith can expel the darkness. It helped me to heal a cursed unicorn and return him to the path of the Light, and you have to do the same, before...
Well, everything in its time. Here, take this. It's an amulet, but it has no magic and no power. There are no easy ways out, ever - they're nothing but a hoax. The amulet must be filled with your own faith, do you understand?
Look in your heart and gather everything that is kind and good - love, hope, beauty... Take this energy of your heart, charge the amulet with it, and then you can heal a unicorn. After you heal him, a single, pure tear will roll down his cheek. Bring me that tear. And remember... You must have faith.
Not working? Unicorns getting aggravated? Look inside your heart - is there faith in it? Believe, then try again... just make sure your faith is with you.
There! Faith has triumphed! As soon as I saw you, I realized that maybe... maybe the wounds the demons inflicted could fire up the faith in your soul.

Kill Sirga the Prophetic and return to Zosim Nikulin.

I wept as I left my sanctuary. I thought it was all over - the inhabitants of Sarnaut would lead themselves to destruction and drown in their own deception, hate, and malice. If a heart is weary with hate, it will never know love and pure faith. But then I realized that if there are still people like you in the world, it might be able to endure.
A demon known as Sirga the Prophetic has invaded the woods and shrouded it in darkness. He is able to survive outside the Astral, and he breathes our air and walks on our soil. This is unprecedented for an Astral demon, and it is a scary tiding indeed!
But we have no time to study how nature allowed this to happen. We must kill him to save our forest, and this job is one I believe you can handle. But do you? Do you believe that? You must if you are to succeed.
Now go into the woods when you have steeled yourself for the battle. That is where the demon has been making his home. I fought him and lost, but I believe you will amend my folly.
The demon... Does he still reign in woods?
I can already start to feel the difference. The rustle of the trees has grown merrier, and I even hear birds cheeping in the distance. The demon must be gone. The woods are saved!
Find the Historian named Bertille de Pluie at Coba Plateau.

You helped open up many new pages of history. Thank you. I promise to dedicate my research on the Itsmal Ruins to you. Perhaps the Historians' gratitude will take on a more substantial shape in the future.
Our world's past hides answers to many of today's questions. If you care about that at all, I suggest you visit Coba Plateau. It's located to the east of Asee-Teph. You won't find any June ruins there, but there are ruins left by the Zem people. They are extremely exciting too.
Please find my friend and colleague Bertille de Pluie. I'm sure she'll be glad for your help. I have no idea where on that dusty Plateau she's located, so keep your eyes peeled. If you see a gorgeous Elven lady, then that's the one!
Antoinette de Grandeur sent you? Why, if you're a friend of hers then you are a friend of mine.
Use the Holy Blade to kill four Mighty Manticores.

Ah, an Imperial tough guy at last! Are you here to test the holy weapons and armor? Good for you! You're in for some unforgettable excitement! Power, strength, and victory - that's what the Empire is after, ain't it?
Now let's get started! The cold steel goes first. Even with the fiercest of enemies, like the fattest, thickest skinned trolls in all of Sarnaut, you just touch them once with this blade and they drop dead. Just like that.
'Course, we couldn't bring a troll here - he'd tear the whole camp apart. But you see those mighty manticores in the testing arena? They're also very worthy opponents. So come on! Hack 'em to pieces! Show them whose boss! Just touch 'em!
So, have you tested the blade yet?
Impressive, eh? Just you wait, it's gonna get even better!
Use the Holy Blade to kill four Mighty Manticores.

Ah, a League tough guy at last!

So, have you tested the blade yet?
Impressive, eh? Just you wait, it's gonna get even better!
Throw 6 Holy Hand Grenades at the Frosty Scorpions.

Now try these holy hand grenades. Don't worry - they won't blow the allod to pieces. In fact, they won't blow anything up at all!
Now hold on, before you start getting all uppity. Remember that most wars are won by cunning! You see, our grenades tame the enemy, turning any belligerent bull dog into a peaceful puppy. There's no need to fight your enemies when they lay down their weapons in front of you!
These scorpions in the enclosure are at your disposal - go ahead and try the grenades on them. C'mon, show 'em! Really give it to ‘em!
See, these scorpions are as docile as cows now. You could milk ‘em and then send ‘em out to pasture! Go ahead, they don't remember ever being aggressive.
I know they've been amazing, but there's still one more incredible innovation to try!
Throw 6 Holy Hand Grenades at the Frosty Scorpions.

Now try these holy hand grenades. Don't worry - they won't blow the allod to pieces. In fact, they won't blow anything up at all!

I know they've been amazing, but there's still one more incredible innovation to try!
Equip the Holy Cloak and withstand the Fierce Cyclops' blows for one full minute.

The last item for you to test is a cloak. But this isn't just any cloak - it's a holy cloak! It's no thicker than any other, but don't be fooled by appearances. It is imbued with powerful magic.
Its fabric can withstand the breath of a hundred Astral demons as well as a direct hit from a mana bomb, which is gonna take another hundred years just to be invented. A cyclops' blow is capable of driving a knight in full armor right into the ground! But this cloak makes it no more harmful than a Gibberling's sneeze.
Go try it out for yourself! You'll find a cyclops in the small enclosure right over there. Go on, I promise you it'll work!
See, was I telling the truth! And you didn't believe me!
Imperial scientists are gonna start losing a lot of sleep when they find out about our holy weapons! There's gonna be some hot auction action real soon, I just know it!
Equip the Holy Cloak and withstand the Fierce Cyclops' blows for one full minute.

See, was I telling the truth! And you didn't believe me!
Aidenus is gonna start losing a lot of sleep when he finds out about our holy weapons! There's gonna be some hot auction action real soon, I just know it!
Share your impressions of the holy weapons with Nomarkh Userkaf.

As you can see, the holy weapons can do anything! They can wipe the enemy off the face of Sarnaut, protect against the strongest of assaults, and even turn yesterday's nemesis into a loyal friend. Even the most cowardly pacifist could win any war with our equipment. Now go and be sure to tell your commander just that!

So, do you have any news? ...Whoa! No way! Never heard of anything like that, and that's weird considering my best friend is an army engineer... The Empire must get these weapons! Then the League will be done for!
Share your impressions of the holy weapons with the Peppy Family.

As you can see, the holy weapons can do anything! They can wipe the enemy off the face of Sarnaut, protect against the strongest of assaults, and even turn yesterday's nemesis into a loyal friend. Even the most cowardly pacifist could win any war with our equipment. Now go and be sure to tell your commander just that!

Are these weapons really that powerful? I can't believe it! The League must have them, no matter the cost! We will win, Yasker's irrational regime will fall, and Sarnaut will finally have peace. We must have them!
Meet with Plu the Tightwad in the Eljune Bazaar.
Plu the Tightwad wishes to see you - he's the one selling the holy weapons. He wants to talk to the Imperial emissary - that's you - in person. So go on, you don't want to keep him waiting.

Ah, there's the emissary... Pleasure to meet you! I hope you liked my holy weapons. I trust that you'll be able to convince your government to loosen their purse strings.
No, no way! Of course I can't tell you where the weapons came from, nor can I reveal their secret. That's proprietary information! But now you've seen for yourselves that all the claims are true, and that's what matters.
In fact, I'd say that the weapons are even more powerful than the rumors made them out to be. But that's not why I summoned you. We have some business to discuss.
Meet with Plu the Tightwad in the Eljune Bazaar.

In fact, I'd say that the weapons are even more powerful than the rumors made them out to be. But that's not why I summoned you. We have some business to discuss.

I want to give you a little gift. Absolutely free, right!
If you're looking for some action, you should make sure to check in with any Free Traders you come across. Most of them need help in a place like this. But if you provide services to my fellows, please let them know you're Plu the Tightwad's partner, okay? Then ask for a note saying that they owe you for this or that.
When you bring the notes to me, I'll upgrade your weapon in exchange. The more you bring, the better they get! Deal? You help them, they help me, I help you - scratch my back, I'll scratch yours, as they say. That's what this brotherhood of Traders is about. So, are we good?
Awesome!! Now you and I are partners, alright? And here's your first present. Pick whatever you like best.

But if you provide services to my fellows, please let them know you're Plu the Tightwad's partner, okay? Then ask for a note saying that they owe you for this or that.

Awesome!! Now you and I are partners, alright? And here's your first present. Pick whatever you like best.
Kill 6 Mantis Warriors or Ravenous Plants and return to Stone the Merciless.

I ain't seen your mug 'round here... Got a pass? You're with the Imperial Army? Alright, better safe than sorry in these areas. I'm with the mercenaries that protect the Traders. They're wimps, can't do nothin' except count coins. That they do well - gotta give 'em that.
There's been so much for the mercenaries to deal with lately - the war, gangs of deserters, wild animals... The animals have gone nuts, ya know! They jus' keep comin' and comin' down here from the west.
The other day we took out some bears for tearing up our fence. Now you ain't gonna see too much of 'em in these parts! Now those mantis and the carnivorous plants, they're stronger and smarter too. So if you wanna help our camp out, go hunt them.
When will these creatures stop flooding the east?
Great! I'll let the Traders know they don't have to keep inside the palisade. For a while anyway...
Collect 6 Scorpion Eggs and bring them to Charles de Pluie.

Whoa, now that was exciting! We should put up a statue to whoever invented animal fights. It's way more civilized when you have beasts duking it out instead of people, don't you think? I'm sure that this is the future of entertainment!
That's why I want to get involved. Actually, I want to become the best known supplier of fighting animals. Here in Eljune there are a ton of vicious beasts, so we have all the prerequisites. Now what should I collect for starters...
Maybe scorpions? They've got those nasty, hard-hitting stingers with all that venom dripping out. Only I don't think I could train a grown scorpion, even though I'm an Elf who grew up in the wild. I think that raising them would be a better idea. Oh, I can't wait to get started!
The first thing I'll need are scorpion eggs, of course. Some people claim they've seen huge scorpions in the Merry Forest. They're even said to have rooted out all the local bears. Get me some of their eggs, will you? Can you imagine what kind of show they're gonna make?!
I've put together a nest for the eggs. I'm sure this plan will go perfectly!
These eggs are perfect! Soon my fighting scorpions will be known all over Sarnaut!
Search the Merry Forest for three girls who ran away from the Forest Butterfly.

Tsk-tsk-tsk, what a bad situation we have here! The Forest Butterfly used to be the only safe place in the forest, and clearly the most fun. That's why they call this place the Merry Forest. Unfortunately, yesterday we had some League deserters as guests.
We don't involve ourselves in politics or war, and we welcome every customer as long as there's coin in their pocket. But these guys were some real ragged bums! The rule has always been no gold, no love but since they were broke they decided to get what they wanted by force.
The girls started running every which way, but not all of them made it out. Even worse, not all of them returned! We're very worried about them, what with all the wolves and scorpions in the woods. And people too - that could pose an even greater danger!
Please help find the three of them we haven't heard from. Help them out of trouble if they need it, and tell them it's safe to come home.
Three of our girls have still not returned. The rest of them can't work until we they find out where they are - they're too stressed! Please help!

Ouch, two of them died... How traumatic for the poor little things! When they're resurrected, they'll need all our care and attention. I suppose we should give them a few days off to let them get over it.
Here's a note indicating the service that you did for us. And take some of this discarded clothing that those deserters left behind - we don't want this around here anymore. I know that roaming about the woods isn't a piece of cake right now, so we really appreciated your help.
Escort the abused girl to Forest Butterfly. Inform the Merry Family about her rescue.

Help! Please save me, I'm begging you! These creeps attacked the Forest Butterfly and abused all my friends - more than once! I ran away into the forest like many other girls, but there I ran into more bad luck - new jerks, just like those other ones.
If it's not too much trouble, please lead me back to the Forest Butterfly. I'm sure it's safe there by now - at least it has to be safer than here. It's not very far, but I'm afraid to go alone - what if I walk into more trouble?!
Talk to the Merry Family after we get there. I'm sure they'll be relieved to know I made it back safely, and they should even give you some coin for your efforts.
Oh gosh, where could our little girls be?

Zabava is safe and sound?! Praise the thread! She's our most talented and hard-working employee. She's the face of our establishment! And she's the one we were worried about the most. Thanks so much for helping!
Kill 6 Silver Wolves and three pack leaders and return to Stone the Merciless.

Several huge wolves were recently spotted in the Merry Forest, to the north of this encampment here. More of those furry out-of-towners that we've been getting, curse them!
The war means that there are heaps of dead bodies lying around in the forest - too many to bury them all. The wolves seem to enjoy scavenging on their rotting meat. Now that's some gross stuff! And there's also a very strategic place located in the Merry Forest - the Forest Butterfly, and we can't have them threatened by the wolves.
We need to teach those beasts to keep their distance! Naturally, they attack in packs, so we should primarily target their pack leaders. Kill the alpha male and his two mates. Then the others will most likely run away with their tails between their legs. Now off you go!
The wolves in the Merry Forest howl so loud at night that the whole camp can hear them. You open your eyes, curse them out, and that's it - there's no going back to sleep.
The pack leaders are all dead? Good job! Now the others will clear off soon enough!
Collect 6 pieces of Slimy Flesh and bring it to Charles de Pluie.

I thought of another type of critter that would be great for the fights - the carnivorous slugs in the Tipsy Thicket. You'd think the arena is no place for a slow, clumsy slug, right? Well, you'd be wrong, but that's okay - you probably grew up in a city!
First of all, slugs have very thick skin and a lot of muscle. Second, their agility rivals that of desert vipers. And finally, if a scorpion or mantis does tear a slug in half... do you think the slug dies? Nope! Two new slugs emerge in its place!
Their ability to multiply makes the slugs virtually indestructible. I think they'll make a great addition to my collection. I'm not asking you to capture a mature slug and drag him over here. Just bring me some of their flesh and then I'll grow and train a nice strong specimen myself.
Nobody at the arena will expect to see a slug in there. That's when the gold starts pouring in, baby!
A bag full of slimy flesh! This is a fortune in the making. Thank you!
Collect 6 Bottles of Vodka from the Imperial Deserters and bring them to Ivan Pavlov.

Don't say anything, I'll do the talking.
No! There's no booze! Come back tomorrow or, even better, next week.
You see, a gang of Imperial deserters cleaned us out last night. Ugh, what kind of tavern has no booze?! A lousy one!
You know, if you're so worried about the situation, perhaps you can help me. The cowardly deserters probably still have most of the stuff. Even they couldn't have emptied the bottles already, the filthy swine!
If you can recover six bottles of vodka for me, our establishment will be very grateful to you!

In these woods vodka is worth its weight in gold. The locals make some kind of stinky moonshine, but it's rumored to have killed as many humans, Orcs, and Elves as the war itself. My booze, on the other hand, is of the highest quality.
Wow, you found quite a bit! From now on you're a special guest here at my watering hole! Buy nineteen shots, get one free on the house!
Kill 6 Cemetery Zombies or Skeletons in the Tipsy Thicket and return to Stone the Merciless

Well, I don't mind if we work together once more.
Before you came along we hired a necromancer, a jolly good fellow who promised he'd purge the forest of every last mantis.
Guess what actually happened - he summoned a bunch of skeletons, but we didn't notice any real improvements. In fact, soon it got even more dangerous, and then this hack got killed off in the local pub. His undead assistants are now at large, roaming the Tipsy Thicket. They've gotten real bad lately, attacking every living thing they see. It even seems like there's more of them somehow... In any case, make them stop, would you?
I might have put a knife in that necromancer myself for being so stupid!

Excellent! Now it should be more peaceful at the tavern. Can you believe that before these animals came from the west, my main chore consisted of picking up drunken Traders from all over the forest. Those were the days!
Light up the eyes of three June statues at the Jakala Ruins and return to the Potbellied Family.

Are you Plu the Tightwad's partner? Great! That means you should be just the person for this job. Now listen up. There are these ancient June ruins nearby, but fifty years ago it was pillaged and anything of value was taken.
Nonetheless, the Historians have taken an interest in the place. They're planning to set up camp here and do some large-scale digging. So, who's going to supply them with the bare essentials? You guessed it - us!
We're this close to closing the deal and signing the contract. However, they're very finicky people and they decided they might want to shop around for other suppliers. That's why we need to convince them that they'll find a lot of interesting stuff there. Then they'll hurry up and choose us so they can set up camp as soon as possible.
There are three June statues in the ruins with their eyes open reaaally wide like this. Apparently, in ancient times a magic light would shine through their eyes and scare away evil spirits. If the Historians see the statues' eyes lit up, they'll be super excited.
Take this magical charge and use it on all three statues. It'll light up their eyes for a bit, and then you can come back here for a reward.
Deserters set up camp in the ruins, but they won't bother a seasoned warrior like you, will they?
Here's some coin and a note outlining how helpful you were! The Historians will be here soon, and I just know we'll get the contract. Thanks!
Collect 6 Giant Pearls from the deserters hiding in the Jakala Ruins and bring them to Semyon Skobelov.

The Jakala Ruins are now home to deserters from both the League and the Empire. A surprising truce indeed. I wish they would use it on something good, like promoting trade, but there's a slim chance of that happening!
They attacked me last night, robbed me and stole a batch of pearls. They're in the woods for pete's sake, what do they think they're gonna do with them?! I doubt they'll risk leaving their camps to sell them. If the rat bastards even know their worth.
I suppose they'll just use them to decorate their camp or something. If you're a true friend of the Free Traders, then go rescue those pearls from those cowardly bums! Of course, the rascals won't just hand them over. Apply as much force as necessary!
Have you recovered my majestic pearls?

Praise the Light! But what is this is? A scratch?! One of the pearls is scratched? How could this happen! This drops the price of the whole batch by half. Well, fine, I'll write you a note indicating the services you provided, but I'll definitely make a note of that scratch.
Get a Treant Sprout from Windbough and bring it to Charles de Pluie.

I've seen an old, mighty treant living in the Jakala Ruins. Judging from his appearance and strength he's weathered a number of serious storms. That's why folks at the camp named him Windbough.
He would be the pinnacle of my collection! Just imagine him entering the arena, his crown tilting menacingly, his mighty branches blocking the sunlight, his prickly limbs reaching at his victim... Even the most vicious scorpion would cower in fear!
Unfortunately, I'll never be able to capture Windbough himself. All I can hope for is getting a young sprout from him. I could grow it into a great big treant whose whole life revolves around the crowd howling at the arena! That would be a dream come true!
I wonder if Windbough would give me a sprout of his as a gift... probably not. Do you think you could take him down and get one by force?
Where's my treant going to live? That's a good question, but let's address problems as they arise! I'll think of something before the sprout takes root...
Wow, you really got one! It looks so soft and frail. I can just see its future power... and I can hear the ring of a coin too.
Sprinkle 6 Majestic Pine Trees with the blood of the fallen and return to Sarbaz Sahure.

Hey listen, I need some urgent help! I've been selling all kinds of incense for years now, and I just had a brilliant idea. I can collect the sap that oozes out of the Holy Land's pine trees and turn it into incense. The pilgrims would just love that! I'm a genius.
But let me get to the point. When I woke up this morning and planned to start my operation, guess what I saw? Dead bodies! That's what I need help with. No, I don't want to remove them, just the opposite!
They were martyrs - they gave their lives for this chapel to Tensess! And that means I could sell the sap of the trees they fell under at double the price! Hey, I bet I could make the stuff even more valuable by sprinkling the trees with the blood of the fallen. Then it would be four times the price!
I called a priest to come here for certification and he's gonna be here any minute. That means I'm running out of time. Please, take this blood and sprinkle the trees with it, okay?
That's right, sprinkle the trees with blood! It'll mean big profits!
You did a good job, and you finished before the priest came. What do you want for your troubles? A note commemorating your services? Sure, here you go.
Destroy 6 Damned Will-o'-the-Wisps by the Holy Spring in 5 minutes for Louis de Blizare.

Mm... come here. How do you feel about putting your weapons to work for a good cause like promoting trade, and not just pointless murder? Hopefully, helping a handsome Elf will sweeten the deal!
You see, I sell holy water from that comes from that spring over there. I've got exclusive rights to it. I could live until the end of my days never lifting a finger, but you know, I really wanna make the business grow. Maybe I could even build a beverage packing plant or something. Manpower is cheap as heck out here in the boonies, so why not?
There's only one little snag. All of a sudden some will-o'-the-wisps appeared near the source. Rumor has it that they're cursed. I have no idea where this cheesy stuff comes from, but the pilgrims who are my customers tend to believe every stupid thing they hear.
I must get rid of every last one of these will-o'-the-wisps, and the sooner, the better. I can't afford to have the pilgrims see them. So, can I hire you to do this?
Faster! We must destroy them as soon as possible before the pilgrims start coming.
Here, take this coin for your work. And let me give you a note indicating your service to the Free Traders. Let me write it up right now... check out my pretty handwriting too!

O, I see this question in your eyes.

Yes, there's real holy water in this spring!
Present the Forestfolks' Birch Bark Document to Beech the Thickskinned.

Wait! The forestfolk need you. You look like a strong warrior, and we need help, we really do. The voices of the forestfolk always fall on deaf ears... All these Traders do is swear and count their gold. But our people our vanishing! Someone must care.
Our chief sent me to this bazaar to find allies. We hoped that many brave souls would pass through here, with hearts full of compassion for the children of nature.
Here, please take this letter. This scroll is covered with the ancient writings of my people. You will find our settlement to the east of Icemirror Lake, by the roaring falls. Show our leader this letter and tell him that I sent you. Then he will tell you what you can do to save us!
Are my eyes deceiving me? This is a birch bark document!
So it is true - we are not alone in this world. Praise be to mother nature for sending us a champion!
Present the Birch Bark Document to Beech the Thickskinned.

Wait! The forestfolk need you. You look like a strong warrior, and we need help, we really do. The voices of the forestfolk always fall on deaf ears... All these Traders do is swear and count their gold. But our people our vanishing! Someone must care.
Our chief sent me to this bazaar to find allies. We hoped that many brave souls would pass through here, with hearts full of compassion for the children of nature.
Here, please take this letter. This scroll is covered with the ancient writings of my people. You will find our settlement to the east of Icemirror Lake, by the roaring falls. Show our leader this letter and tell him that I sent you. Then he will tell you what you can do to save us!
Are my eyes deceiving me? This is a birch bark document!
So it is true - we are not alone in this world. Praise be to mother nature for sending us a champion!

The pipe... Where did you get it? It's a secret!

Alright, I'll tell you, although we don't tell out secrets to strangers.

There's a legend that is passed from generation to generation.

A powerful race once lived here. You call this race the Junes.

Forestfolk were just a part of a large nation that united Waterfolk and Mountainfolk. We were proud and numerous. We occupied all land and wanted more. So we engaged in warfare with Junes!

Of course, they were much stronger. In the end, we lost. We couldn't count the victims, and the Junes chased us down to the edge of the land. We ran and scattered across the world...
h: Do you know what this reed pipe is for?

t:
We begged the Junes for forgiveness!

And they spared our lives. They switched to a war with dragons...

By that time, our folk has split. Those who could talk with trees became Forestfold. Those who speak with the river became Waterfolk, and Mountainfolk were the people of mountains.

June helped us like no one helped us before. And there was the day when they needed our help!

Their people split as well. Some of them remained the June people and came to this village, which has been on this river bank for thousands of years. Rumor has it, it was warmer before.

But their Curse was awake! It followed them. A June gave his life to protect his own kin and my tribe. We saved our lives while he was standing guard.

We've been worshipping the hero ever since. Sometimes his spirit pays a visit.
I'd normally say no, but you're a great hero! Here is our tribe's mask.
h: May I participate in the ritual?

t: Kill 6 Lake Lizard Warriors and return to Beech the Thickskinned.

The woods rustle and the river roars - a dark night is moving from the west, scaring all living things away.
Evil lizardmen came along the river, looking to take this land by force. But we will not leave! We are peaceful hunters and gatherers, we make no wars and never bother anybody. Yet we will sooner lay down our lives than give our land away!
If you are a friend of the forestfolk, then you will help us drive them back! May your brave heart beat strong in your chest, and may your arms be steady! Please do not fail us in this dire hour. Those lizardmen must learn that the forestfolk do not surrender!

Dark times are upon us forestfolk. We are a kind people, and we would gladly share our land with the lizardmen. But alas, they are no peaceful fishermen. Instead they are hateful warriors, attacking anything with flesh they can sink their teeth into.
Good tidings! Now us forestfolk can live as one with nature, hunting wild animals and fishing in the river. No longer shall we be afraid of a cruel death in the night!
Collect River Fish from the Forestfolk' Nets, kill 6 Huge Pikes, and return to Orn the Tireless.

I would treat you to some delicious fish, but we haven't had any since the last moon.
Hungry times are soon to be upon us! The great monstrous fish that live in the lake have been moving up the river, with fins as sharp as knives and jaws like a vice. They tear up our nets and even attack our fishermen, dragging them down into the deep water.
Because of them we haven't tasted fish for many a day! We are too little and too few too to fight these scary fish. But you are so mighty and strong! Could you give them a good thrashing? These monstrous fish mainly lurk farther down the river.
Oh, and can you check our nets to see if we have been blessed with a decent catch? Anything you can find will help us fight off hunger for a few more days.
Lizardmen on the land, fish in the water... There's no place to hide.
Thank you! Soon enough my net will flutter with a fresh catch. See you, I'm going fishing!
Bring 6 Sharp Wolf Fangs and 6 Hard Wolf Bones to Ird the Deadly.

There are fewer and fewer fish in the river, and we hunters must spend more time catching what remains. But while we feed our tribe, we must also prepare to fight those evil lizardmen.
Their hides are as tough as a tree - only one in ten arrows goes through. Usually my quiver can be emptied in less than a day when I am fighting those beasts.
Please help us! We make arrowheads from wolf teeth and bones. But it will take me three days and three nights if I hunt for these materials alone! Any help that you could give me would ensure that my tribe is not caught unawares if the lizardmen attack again.
I'm down to my last arrow... If a lizardman attacks me, then I'll put it right through his eyes. And then I'll fight with my bare hands if I must!
Oh, thank you! I will sharpen them until tomorrow's moon comes. They will make for great arrowheads!
Find a captain at the Takalik Harbor who will venture to the Edge of Eternal Night.

Here's what we need to do. In the western part of Eljune there is a place called the Edge of Eternal Night. There is a very potent Site of Power situated there, and that's where the animals appear to be running away from. No one knows what's going on there, and that's what we must find out!
I cannot send you there because your life is too valuable to the Empire. I've given this a lot of thought and the only replacements I can think of are the desperate sailors from Takalik Harbor, which lies in the northwestern part of Eljune.
Here are your funds. Now go find some reckless captain and convince him to venture to the Edge of Eternal Night. His scouting report will be very useful, and if he doesn't come back at all then we'll know it's really serious!

So you want us to go to the Edge of Eternal Night? No animals ever go near that place. Well, we're not dumb like animals, and we've been to places you couldn't even imagine, baby! But it's gonna cost you. Let me see that purse again... hmm...

Alright, I'll do it! After all, sailing to the Edge of Eternal Night ain't the same as supplying the Empire with ammunition while under fire from the League's ships. We've got a deal! We'll come back soon and let you know what happened.
Report the scouts' message to Colonel Georgi Batalov at the Kotelny Camp.

If only we had known! A dozen purses like yours would have never budged us or our boat! Do you even know what's going on there? The shore is occupied by cultists and the Astral is teeming with demons!
And that's just what we had time to see. We were there for about two minutes before we turned our ship around and hauled ass out of there! Our official advice is to stay far, far away from that cursed coast!
We're not going back either, no way. In fact, we're pulling anchor right now and going home, never to set foot in the Holy Land again! Sacred my butt. It sure looks cursed to me!
I hope you found one single hothead in the whole port. All they gotta do is turn the corner of this allod. For the money I'm paying, it's a dream job!
I hope you found one single hothead in the whole port. All they gotta do is turn the corner of this allod. For the money I'm paying, it's a dream job!
Bring 6 Veneris Berries to Rusk the Forester in June Itsmal.

What am I doing here? Have you been to the Imperial camp recently? Half the soldiers have some nasty disease. They ought to ease up on the brothel visits and start thinking of their souls!
Now I'm stuck doing the job of an army doctor instead of practicing my ancient magic. I've been crawling on my knees to gather the berries of a rare plant called veneris.
Someone's got to save the regiment, I suppose. Can you imagine reporting to your commander that you've been defeated because your soldiers have some horrible rashes?
You're very welcome to give me a hand. In fact, I'd appreciate it very much. The plants grow all around here. Just pick as many berries as you can find.
We ought to add bromine to their water! I hear it works great for the recruits in the Igsh Military District. So, have we got enough berries?
Great! Now to get started on those poultices.
Find the Great Ascetic Zosim Nikulin in the western part of the Zosim Coast.

To the west of here is Zosim Coast, named after a great ascetic who lives there. Before he devoted his life to serving the Light, he was Zosim Nikulin, a fearless Kanian warrior.
In the Great Astral Campaign he and I fought side by side, shoulder to shoulder. When you're up against giant Astral demons, you tend to take any allies you can get. And this may sound a little treasonous, but he was a very admirable man and an incredible fighter.
If anyone knows more than me about demons, it's Zosim. Besides, as I spent all these years walking the roads in my army boots, he's been improving his mind and body. The flow of pilgrims seeking his blessing does not cease.
Who knows, perhaps his insight will reveal truths we could have never imagined. I wouldn't bother him over trifles, but right now we cannot do without his advice.
I can see through hills and forests...

You seek information about the Edge of Eternal Night? Once, a long time ago, a June temple stood there that was called the Temple of Endless Night. No traces of it exist anymore - the earth cracked and the temple slipped into the Astral. But in its place emerged a Site of Power, the most powerful one in the Holy Land.
Since then it has been contaminated by demon worshippers. Now the place is full of darkness. They say something similar has happened in Asee-Teph, but the destruction here is much more serious.
The demonic disciples have amassed great strength, and they sow more evil every day. There is only one way that I can think of that will defeat them. But it is a very difficult feat...
Talk to Yasskul Minkhaf on the Zosim Coast.

I'd like to know where that Ascetic Zosim disappeared to! The League has to be the cause of this - maybe they're even behind this demonic scare! Maybe they even used the mental powers of those cursed Gibberlings to control the demons! Whatever the case may be, we will reveal their true colors!
The Great Ascetic is one of the only living people in Sarnaut who is respected by both the League and the Empire. His spirit is pure, and he wields enormous power.
The League priest Amvonov and I met with him a few days ago. Of course the Kanian did nothing but bicker, and I couldn't convey any of the Empire's message. Then he disappeared without a trace before I had a chance to speak with him again.
Fortunately, Yasker's personal emissary is scheduled to arrive in the Holy Land soon. She carries various documents outlining the League's treachery and the demonic nature of those Gibberlings, and she shall get him to ally with our great nation.
Unfortunately, the soldiers we sent to wait for her were attacked! The League sent a squad of troops against us, and they're doing everything they can to interfere with our plans. Head to the shore quickly and talk to Major Yasskul Minkhaf. It is critical that nothing bad happens to the emissary!
What do you want? Quit bothering me! Oh, you're from Lampov? Yeah, we've got enough work for everyone!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Kill 6 League Militia and return to Yasskul Minkhaf. Report back to Yasskul Minkhaf.

The Imperial ships will be here soon and they will be carrying Yasker's emissary. It is of the utmost importance that she gets here safe and sound so we can begin negotiations with Zosim. Yes I know he is missing, but I'm sure that by the time the emissary gets here our troops will manage to find him!
The biggest threat to us right now is that League battalion. They've been sending small raids against us for a while, and we've managed to hold our own. But that is not enough - we must take complete control of this coast immediately.
Most of their soldiers are coming from the League camp to the west, and their numbers need to be scaled down as soon as possible. I order you to destroy the enemy's troops! Every last one of them!
Make your report! Did you carry out my order?
Good job! But remember - this just the beginning.

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Kill the 6 League Magicians and return to Yasskul Minkhaf.

It looks like the enemy has decided to use tricks and deception. According to my report, there are a few League mages performing some kind of magic ritual on the shore - even as we speak! Supposedly, they are trying to open up a portal to their ship so as to reinforce the crew.
We cannot allow their magic to be completed, whatever it takes! I order you to destroy the League mages before this happens. They shall learn that underhanded methods are not going to get them any closer to earning Zosim's approval.
Oh, soon our ship will arrive and then all of this nonsense will be over. The Great Ascetic will recognize the Empire as being the most just, and then the League will retreat in humiliation! I can't wait!
We cannot let the League's mages open a portal to their ship!
Are they all dead? Great job! Now their plans will crumble!
Kill Stanislav Kubarev and report to Yasskul Minkhaf.

The best way to break the enemy's morale is to get rid of their leader. Most soldiers are mindless buffoons, and without the commanding words of their superiors they flounder and flee in terror.
Recently the League sent a centurion to their outpost on the Zosim Coast. His name is Stanislav Kubarev, and he is apparently one of their most seasoned warriors. They say that he has taken out an entire Imperial platoon by himself. Pah!
I think it is time to dispel these unfounded rumors. Head on over to that camp and take care of him personally. Then the League's emissary will get a very poor welcome indeed, if he makes it here at all!
Without their leader, the League's troops will turn into a herd of disordered peasants. Incidentally, they resemble a herd as it is...
The centurion is dead? That is excellent! I wish I could have heard his death cry myself.
Report to Yasskul Minkhaf, then greet and defend Yasker's emissary on the Zosim Coast.

Damnit! Apparently the emissary has already landed without sending so much as a single warning. Ugh! Quick, run for the shore! We must greet her immediately and provide adequate protection.
The League will definitely attempt to kill her and capture her documents, which reveal the sinister intents of the League. They know that if Zosim gets hold of them, their days in the Holy Land are numbered.
Hurry up. If the emissary dies, none of us will ever enjoy life again! Yasker will personally make sure of that!
Finally! Why has it taken so long to send help?

So this is the kind of welcome that Yasker's personal emissary gets, huh?! I guess those reports that said the Holy Land was almost ours were a sham. I'll tell Yasker everything about what happened, everything!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Bring the news of the emissary's safe arrival to Irina Lazareva near the Zosim Coast.

Hurry and run to Zosim's sanctuary. Lampov needs to be informed immediately that the emissary has arrived! We must make preparations for her meeting with Zosim, and we need to request more troops from headquarters. I can't imagine how furious Yasker would be if we got the emissary here safely, only to have her killed in the night!
I'm sure Lampov will give you a good reward considering your role in our operation! Me, I need to take a breather after all of this chaos. I believe I'm entitled to a shot of good hard liquor! Maybe I can even get my commander to give me some time off next week. Now why are you standing here? off you go!

The League has no hope of winning now. The information in our documents is neatly organized, and Zosim will understand their treachery right away.
I don't suppose you know when Zosim is coming back? I suppose we'll just wait here for his return. Meanwhile, please accept this well-deserved reward from the Empire!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Use the Amulet of True Faith to purify the Site of Power at the Edge of Eternal Night and inform Georgi Batalov of your deeds.

Faith! Your faith is capable of saving a unicorn, maybe it will also be capable of saving all of Eljune.
Do you believe that it's possible? Now that the Amulet is filled with your faith, it can purify the Cursed Site of Power in the Edge of Eternal Night. But to reach it, you will need more than just faith! You'll also need strong arms, quick feet, and a sharp mind. The Edge of Eternal Night is devoid of any living soul or innocent animal. No one knows for certain what awaits you there...
I wish to go with you... My spirit reaches out, but my legs won't obey. All I can do is give you my blessing. Now go!
Is it just me or are the animals beginning to move back home, to the west?

The contagion in Eljune should soon begin to fade. You weren't even born when I fought in the Great Astral Campaign, and it has been the source of my pride, the reason I put myself above you kids. But now I see that every generation is capable of miracles. Congratulations on saving us all!
Kill Kilza the Shadowy and bring his heart to Colonel Georgi Batalov at the Kotelny Camp.

There's one demon that rules the other monsters that inhabit the Edge of Eternal Night. He is called Kilza the Shadowy, and judging from his dark fruits of his labor, his power is a hundred times greater. You need to face this demon, and rip his heart right out of his chest! That should slow down their activities.
What will happen to the world if Astral demons spread across all the allods? They would exterminate everyone else - the furry Gibberlings, the beautiful Elves, the intelligent Arisen, the freedom-loving Orcs...
We cannot let that happen! We must slow the demons' activities and then discover their plans. Once you kill Kilza the Shadowy, bring his heart to Colonel Batalov. He's an old war dog and he'll know what it means.
Do you have good news to report?

A demon heart!? I saw many similar hearts during the Great Astral Campaign, but none of them were so huge, so... frightening. It seems like I can feel the darkness it exudes. This heart confirms that the threat is grave, and we must remain on our toes.
